# GitHubTuijian

> Curated Open-Source Projects, Developer Tools & High-Performance Web Architectures.

## About
GitHubTuijian is an independent technical publication and developer platform built with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and modern web standards. It delivers in-depth architectural reviews, technical SEO insights, and high-quality open-source recommendations with perfect Lighthouse performance.

## Key Technical Features
- Built on Astro 5+ and Tailwind CSS v4 with Static Site Generation (SSG).
- 100/100 Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse scores for SEO, Performance, Best Practices, and Accessibility.
- Comprehensive Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, Breadcrumbs, Articles).
- Accessible design system with zero-FOUC dark mode and native responsive navigation.
- Native multi-language (i18n) support with canonical URLs and automated hreflang tagging.
